name: Melanocyte MITF-M program with light-induced pigmentation
rationale: All members concern melanocyte biology under MITF-M (target-gene programs, melanin synthesis, pigment granules, melanocyte proliferation/differentiation); unlike the MITF-M confusables that carry cell-cycle and DNA-repair targets, this theme has melanin biosynthesis, albinism and UV-A/blue-light responses.

name: Epithelial salt and water homeostasis under osmotic stress
rationale: Members cover sodium, potassium and chloride transport (cation-chloride cotransporters, Bartter/Gitelman, K+ channels) that set cell volume and renal/intestinal salt balance; the theme is set apart by hyper/hypo-osmotic and salt-stress responses, water homeostasis and paracellular/chloride diarrhoea members the confusables lack.

name: Early secretory pathway for ER membrane proteins
rationale: Members span SRP-dependent and tail-anchored insertion of proteins into the ER membrane through COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi export; unlike confusables dominated by COPI retrograde traffic, ERAD and folding, this theme has multi-pass membrane protein insertion and connexin assembly.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling limiting cytosolic calcium
rationale: Members regulate SR/ER calcium pumps, ryanodine-receptor release, Na+/Ca2+ exchange and calcium sequestration, all lowering cytosolic calcium; confusables add positive release and cardiac contraction while this theme has SERCA regulation, caffeine response and cytosolic Ca2+ reduction.

name: Erythroid differentiation to mature red cells
rationale: Members describe erythroid lineage commitment (TAL1-GFI1B), its transcriptional control and late red-cell membrane assembly; unlike confusables centred on megakaryocytes/platelets or haematopoietic stem cells, this theme is restricted to the red-cell branch.

name: Ornithine transcarbamylase step of urea cycle
rationale: All members concern the urea-cycle reaction making citrulline toward arginine and its deficiency variants; confusables cover other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ammonium/ornithine handling, while this theme is defined by the ornithine transcarbamylase step.

name: Antimicrobial killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members concern direct host killing of microbes (neutrophil cytotoxicity, cytolysis, metal sequestration by antimicrobial proteins); unlike confusables built on respiratory burst, degranulation or iron assimilation, this theme has antifungal and Gram-positive defence.

name: Hexose absorption and storage as glycogen
rationale: Members cover hexose digestion, intestinal/renal sugar transport and glycogen synthesis/breakdown with their storage diseases; the glycogen members distinguish it from the transport-only confusables, and the absorption members from the glycolysis/gluconeogenesis confusables.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signalling with cancer receptor mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor signalling through SMADs and its regulators (TGFBR3, RUNX3, follistatin); the cancer-associated TGFBR/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets separate it from the confusable lacking them, while its core SMAD signalling separates it from the RUNX3-only confusable.

core: Antigen receptor signalling with co-receptor tuning
qualifier: in both T and B cells
name: Co-receptor-tuned antigen receptor signalling in T and B cells
rationale: Members are proximal TCR and BCR signalling plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibition; the confusables are T-cell-only, whereas this theme includes BCR signalling and its regulation.

name: Epithelial solute carrier transport, chiefly amino acids
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane solute carriers and their disorders, mostly amino acid and peptide transport plus urate and organic anion carriers; the amino acid/peptide members separate it from the hexose and organic-cation confusables.

qualifier: by endothelial and smooth muscle cells
name: Vascular remodelling by endothelial and smooth muscle cells
rationale: Members regulate blood and lymphatic vessel growth via VEGF/Tie endothelial signalling and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching; one confusable lacks the smooth muscle arm and the others lack the VEGF/endothelial arm.

name: Amino acid metabolism with tyrosine catabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid synthesis and degradation (tyrosine/phenylalanine, proline, glycine, glyoxylate); tyrosine catabolism distinguishes it from three confusables, and proline/glycine metabolism from the phenylalanine confusable.

name: Osteoblast commitment of mesenchymal progenitors
rationale: Members concern mesenchymal stem cell expansion and osteoblast differentiation driven by RUNX2, Wnt, BMP and mechanical load; confusables instead centre on chondrocytes, osteoclasts/mineralisation or collagen secretion.

name: B cell development and activation through BCR signalling
rationale: Members cover B cell development, proliferation, survival and activation; proximal BCR signalling (BTK, RAS, CD22, second messengers) distinguishes it from confusables focused on plasma, memory and germinal-centre differentiation.

name: MECP2-dependent neuronal gene regulation
rationale: Most members describe MECP2 binding, regulation and target genes in neurons with HDAC and translational repression, alongside sensory behaviours affected in Rett syndrome; confusables are behaviour/circuit groupings lacking the MECP2 machinery.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription control including termination
rationale: Members regulate the RNA polymerase II cycle from preinitiation and elongation to termination and R-loop resolution; termination and R-loop members distinguish it from the elongation-focused confusable and from the broad RNA-processing confusable.

name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release controlling cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-receptor calcium release, calcium removal and the resulting cardiac contraction, relaxation and rate; the cardiac contraction members distinguish it from SERCA-uptake confusables.

name: p53-induced apoptosis via BH3-only mitochondrial permeabilization
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of death genes and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only activation releasing cytochrome c; unlike confusables built on BAX/BAK oligomerization or generic p53 apoptosis regulation, it couples p53 targets to BH3-only proteins.

name: Ovarian cycle from follicle growth to luteolysis
rationale: Members follow follicle growth, oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteinization and luteolysis; confusables centre on gonadotropin secretion and response and lack luteolysis and oocyte maturation.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport including Hartnup disorder
rationale: All members concern amino acid import across the plasma membrane and its transporter defects; Hartnup and tryptophan members distinguish it from one confusable, and SLC1A1/SLC6A14 members from the iminoglycinuria-centred confusables.

name: Centrosome-nucleated microtubules orienting the mitotic spindle
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation/anchoring and astral microtubules that orient the spindle; spindle orientation and asymmetric division separate it from centrosome-maturation and cytokinesis confusables.

name: Plasma membrane protein delivery via endocytic recycling
rationale: Members concern returning receptors and proteins from endosomes and Golgi to the plasma membrane; confusables centre on Golgi-endosome-lysosome and retrograde traffic rather than recycling.

name: Cardiac muscle adaptation including contractile force
rationale: Members regulate cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, survival, hypertrophy and contraction; contractile force and heart rate members separate it from the calcineurin hypertrophy confusable, and its cardiac focus from the smooth-muscle confusables.

name: Golgi architecture remodelling and membrane tubulation
rationale: Members concern Golgi ribbon formation, disassembly/reassembly, positioning and membrane tubulation; confusables centre on Golgi vesicle traffic and secretion rather than organelle structure.

name: Damaged DNA base repair including alkylation reversal
rationale: Members are base excision repair steps and glycosylase defects plus direct reversal of alkylation damage; direct reversal separates it from BER-only confusables, and gap-filling/glycosylase defects from the others.

name: RHO-family GTPase cycles including RHOA subfamily
rationale: All members are RHO-family GTPase activation cycles and signalling (RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOG/J/D, formins); RHOA/B/C distinguish it from two confusables, with formin and CDC42/RHOG members distinguishing it from the RAC and ROCK/RND confusables.

name: Heme-derived bilirubin clearance by the liver
rationale: Members cover heme degradation to bilirubin, its hepatic organic-anion uptake, glucuronidation and export, and hereditary hyperbilirubinemias; confusables share the transporters but concern drug ADME rather than bilirubin.

core: Imino acid and glycine transport defects
name: Imino acid and glycine transport defects in iminoglycinuria
rationale: All three members are transporter defects causing iminoglycinuria and hyperglycinuria; confusables cover other amino acid, sugar and urate transport disorders.

name: Motor control circuits of cerebellum and striatum
rationale: Members concern locomotion, motor learning, proprioception and development of the cerebellum and striatum; confusables add vocal and sensory behaviour or glial/precursor development rather than motor control.
